name: Feature request

title: '[feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## The problem

What you're trying to do, and where the current system falls short. Concrete is better than abstract — describe a specific situation where you'd reach for this.

## What you'd like

How you'd want it to work. Sketches and rough APIs are welcome.

## Alternatives

Other ways you've considered, including doing nothing.

## Out of scope

This project is paper-only by design. Features that target a live brokerage account, or that would surface vendor names in the user-facing UI, will not be merged. If your request needs either, mention it here so we can discuss alternatives.
